# 雲菴克文禪師語錄（敘．疏．附錄）

**ID:** X1342
**Volume:** X69

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-juan paratext-and-appendix collection for Kèwén's *yǔlù*, X69 n1342. Non-commentary; *commentedTextid* omitted. The main body of the *yǔlù* proper is preserved separately; this text provides the front-and-back matter.

[Zhēnjìng Kèwén](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%8B%E6%96%87) 真淨克文 (1025–1102), *shì* Yúnān 雲庵: major Northern-Sòng Huánglóng-lineage Chán master; dharma-heir of [Huánglóng Huìnán](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%85%A7%E5%8D%97) 黃龍慧南. Teacher of [Juéfàn Huìhóng](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BE%B7%E6%B4%AA) and of multiple other prominent Northern-Sòng Línjì masters.

Compiler [Fúshēn](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%A6%8F%E6%B7%B1) 福深: dharma-heir (*sìfǎ* 嗣法) of Kèwén; compiler of the paratexts.

Dating: *notBefore* c. 1095 (late Kèwén teaching-period); *notAfter* c. 1150 (publication-horizon).
